summary: Mary Finnegan, 82, of Delta County went missing (dementia); car found ~4-5 mi off Divide Road near the Mesa-Montrose county line; body found Aug 2 ~3 mi from car by family after official 5-day search suspended.
location: off Divide Road near the Mesa-Montrose County line, Uncompahgre National Forest
notes: Missing since Jul 15 (last seen at Rose Bowl bowling alley, Montrose; Jul 15, 2016 was a Friday per Kool1079); car found Jul 17; official search of 40-60 searchers suspended; body found by family Aug 2 following rancher tip; victim from Delta County, search led by Mesa County SO.
